hero.bubble: Hi, I'm RepoChan! Scroll down with me ↓

analysis.tag: [stage 01] repochan analysis — deterministic scan + LLM enhancement
analysis.titleHtml:
Read the repo first.
Then talk about its soul.
analysis.noteHtml: The first runner in this relay is not a paintbrush — it's a scanner. 434 files, 44,388 lines of code, directory structure, README tone, the date of the first commit — all of it becomes clues for the character. Her birthday, 06-13, is this repo's very first commit.

lines.html: ⠋ Scanning repository… docs/ packages/ scripts/ test-repos/
→ naming seeds: "RepoChan" · "Chan" · "Turn any git repository into a living mascot"

persona.tag: [stage 02] repochan persona create — World Architect × Character Designer × Consistency Guardian
persona.titleHtml:
Fragments snap into place,
and she comes alive.
persona.subHtml: A persona here is never a whim. Three agent roles collaborate — the World Architect builds the Sugar Riff studio first, the Character Designer assembles her from the analysis report's clues, and the Consistency Guardian rejects anything that "isn't her". Weight matching, anti-overfitting, anti-language-leak — all written into the skill.

dossier.avatarAlt: Chibi RepoChan holding up her own drawing
dossier.name: RepoChan
dossier.role: 16 · high-schooler × freelance illustrator · runs the "Sugar Riff" studio
dossier.mottoQuote: "Drawing and rock are the same thing: both smash what's inside you out into the world."

foundation.titleHtml:
Foundation first.
It is the visual anchor for everything downstream.
foundation.subHtml: Six-color palette, expression variants, key motifs, icon sketches — all locked in on this one sheet. Every later brushstroke must pass it as --reference. Foundation first — that's what consistency means. What you're looking at is the real output of ord-foundation-001, not a mockup.
foundation.sheetAlt: RepoChan foundation sheet — key visual, expression variants, palette, key motifs

painter.tag: [stage 04] repochan image gen × 6 orders — all referencing the foundation sheet
painter.titleHtml:
The painter gets to work,
and assets pour out.
painter.subHtml: Stickers, pattern, poster, web-state tiles, banner, icon — every one generated with the foundation as reference, so every stroke is "her". Keep scrolling; the orders land one by one.

items.alt: state tile: investigating with a magnifier

page.tag: [stage 05] page assembly — web-designer / page-designer take the order
page.titleHtml:
The final leg —
is this very page.
page.subHtml: The page you're scrolling right now is the pipeline's final artifact. The foundation sheet, stickers, poster, pattern, character cutouts above — not a single stock image; everything came from the previous four stages.
page.echoHtml: In the mini browser on the left lives the pipeline itself: analysis → persona → foundation → painter → page. By the time you scroll here, all six cells are lit. This website was built by the pipeline it describes.
page.cameoAlt: RepoChan pointing at the mini browser
